{"query":"# Need add use functional juniper Relationships
query selectComponentFullDataQuery{
  components (
    uuidComponent: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    uuid
    uuidComponentParent
    name
    description
    uuidUser
    idTypeAccess
    idComponentType
    idActualStatus
    isStandard
    isDelete
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
  
  paramComponent (
    uuidComponent: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    id
    uuid
    idParam
    value
  }
  
  files (
    uuidComponent: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    uuid
    uuidFileParent
    uuidUser
    filename
    idExt
    valueExt
    createdAt
    filesize
    pathFile
  }
  
  componentModification (
    uuidComponent: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {    
    uuid
    uuidComponent
    uuidModificationParent
    modificationName
    description
    idActualStatus
    isDelete
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
  
  paramModification (
    uuidModification: "aba22d59-4f6c-44a4-9a37-2d38f0e577a8"
  ) {
    id
    uuid
    idParam
    value
  }
}
","operationName":"selectComponentFullDataQuery"}
